claim_text: Tree-based retrieval supports coarse-to-fine scoring with logarithmic dependence on corpus size under fixed branching and beam assumptions.
verification_rule: Primary paper supports the characterization
notes: Complexity claim is scoped to the cited formulation.

claim_text: JTM alternates optimization of the tree index and the preference model.
verification_rule: Primary proceedings page and paper
notes: No claim that PTD is the first joint tree method.

claim_text: The frozen teacher score is pCTR times pCVR from an ESMM-style model.
verification_rule: Primary paper defines the factorization
notes: Implementation identity is also recorded in verified evidence.

claim_text: The verified legacy evaluation contains 12844800 test rows on five dates spanning 16 days.
verification_rule: SHA-256 and JSON pointers must match
notes: This does not measure PTD.

claim_text: The legacy ESMM anchor attains purchase NDCG@50 0.1762586881 and AUC 0.7938028540 on that universe.
verification_rule: Values must match /summary/legacy_esmm
notes: Context only; not a PTD result.

claim_text: PTD distills frozen purchase-aware sibling distributions at item and internal-node levels.
verification_rule: Method must match preregistration
notes: Proposed method statement; not an empirical result.

claim_text: Tree reassignment uses training data only and locks before test scoring.
verification_rule: Run manifest must attest all cutoffs
notes: Any post-test reassignment invalidates the run.

claim_text: PTD improves purchase NDCG@50 over fixed-tree TDM.
verification_rule: Requires valid five-day evidence plus positive corrected CI and passing guardrails
notes: Forbidden in abstract/conclusion until verified.

claim_text: Item- and node-sibling distillation are complementary.
verification_rule: Requires registered ablation contrasts
notes: No one-day diagnostic may satisfy this claim.

claim_text: Train-only alternating optimization improves PTD.
verification_rule: Requires fixed-versus-alternating registered contrast
notes: No result currently ingested.

claim_text: The HSTU encoder improves the quality-latency frontier.
verification_rule: Requires matched encoder ablation plus latency record
notes: No result currently ingested.

claim_text: The authors saw legacy results on the five dates before registering PTD analyses.
verification_rule: Disclosure appears verbatim in preregistration
notes: Prospective refers to PTD readout rather than unseen dates.

claim_text: The admission checker fails closed on false assertions, hash mismatch, missing variants, deviations, and invalid timestamps.
verification_rule: All negative-path unit tests and the valid-pair test must pass
notes: This verifies contract enforcement rather than PTD efficacy.

claim_text: The reference evaluator deterministically implements ranking metrics, paired date-stratified bootstrap, Holm adjustment, and registered guardrails.
verification_rule: Metric/bootstrap/multiplicity/guardrail tests must pass
notes: This verifies statistical plumbing rather than an empirical effect.

claim_text: The admission checker recomputes aggregate primary metrics and contrasts from hash-linked complete date-user-seed rows and admits valid negative outcomes without promoting success claims.
verification_rule: Hash mismatch and aggregate/contrast tampering must fail while a consistent guardrail failure remains admissible
notes: This prevents unverifiable aggregate claims and success-biased evidence filtering.

claim_text: The frozen raw input inventory contains 216 generation-pinned Parquet objects and 23761140 rows with sequence, category, and point-in-time timestamp fields aligned to the verified split totals.
verification_rule: Inventory validator must confirm uniform schema object identity and exact split row counts
notes: Metadata provenance only; it does not establish PTD efficacy or semantic leakage safety.

claim_text: The frozen source stores separate most-recent-first click and purchase sequences capped at 30 without per-event timestamps or a cross-stream total order.
verification_rule: Source SQL hash and extracted sequence semantics must match the validator
notes: This bounds the implementable encoder and forbids fabricated time-gap features.

claim_text: The registered catalog envelope has 5584 items; 2339 test items are absent from train and validation.
verification_rule: Outcome-free aggregate audit and candidate-set hashes must reproduce
notes: Product identifiers and category payloads are not published.

claim_text: The prospective PTD run uses the hash-pinned two-stream encoder and transductive binary depth-13 catalog/tree contract.
verification_rule: Run manifest must carry the exact method source tree and eligibility hashes
notes: This is a method commitment not an efficacy claim.

claim_text: The recovered one-day TDM runner is not sufficient to execute the registered PTD experiment.
verification_rule: Code hashes and six registered incompatibilities must match the validator
notes: Prevents a convenient but methodologically different runner from being mislabeled as PTD.

claim_text: The frozen-teacher materializer loads the exact checkpoint and preserves the pCTR times pCVR factorization without reading labels.
verification_rule: Exact checkpoint hash synthetic outputs factorization and no-overwrite checks must pass
notes: Synthetic compatibility evidence only; no PTD effect is measured.

claim_text: The catalog builder reproduces the 5584-item depth-13 tree envelope and all registered date eligibility hashes from the immutable raw inventory.
verification_rule: Real-source counts hashes tree shape and non-outcome column boundary must match
notes: Keyed bundle remains access-controlled; public evidence contains counts and hashes only.
